text: Across these 14 categories: 7.8% of reviewer opinions vs 17.0% of owner opinions. Owners bring it up more in 13 of the 14; tennis ball machines are the exception, with only 91 owner opinions. 6,900 opinions from YouTube reviews and 3,567 from Reddit threads. Left out: video doorbells, smart thermostats, mechanical keyboards and 3D scanners, where reliability isn't a topic of its own (it's folded into a broader one such as "Connection, Reliability & Support") , and pickleball machines, which have no Reddit threads yet. Reviewers and owners talk about apps, software and connectivity about equally often ( 8.2% vs 9.4% of opinions). They don't agree on them: 21% of reviewer opinions on apps are negative, compared with 71% of owner opinions. Categories with at least 20 positive or negative owner opinions on apps. Owners are more negative in all eight. Two products show where this ends up: BettaScore ranks products by what public reviews say about them. No brand pays to be listed or to rank higher, and our shopping links earn nothing.
